architecture.mechanism: anomaly detection using OBD-II sensor data and machine learning models
architecture.intervention: Deploy a supervised or unsupervised machine learning model to analyze real-time OBD-II parameters (engine load, coolant temperature, throttle position) for patterns indicative of head gasket failure or coolant leakage prior to cylinder intrusion, triggering an early warning or limp mode.
architecture.expected_effect: Early identification of cooling system integrity loss allows for preventative maintenance before coolant intrudes into cylinders, preventing hydrostatic lock and engine damage while maintaining drivability until the fault is confirmed.
architecture.falsification_test: Inject simulated coolant leak signatures into OBD-II data streams from a healthy engine and verify if the ML model triggers a false positive anomaly alert within 50 drive cycles.
